title: Lebesgue measure of a parameter set is at most H^n of its rotated graph
statement: For all natural numbers n, l, every linear isometry q of R^(n+l), every map u : R^n -> R^l and every set A contained in R^n (no measurability or regularity assumed): L^n(A) <= H^n(q(graph u over A)), where graph u over A = {graphPoint(x, u(x)) : x in A}, graphPoint(x, y) = (x, y) in R^n x R^l = R^(n+l), L^n = volume on R^n and H^n = muHE[n] on R^(n+l).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (u : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (A : Set (Rn n)), volume A ≤ (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (q '' graphOver u A)
